discussion.p: jam.jit.gl.ilda.sketch uses a jit.gl.sketch object internally to render the graphics. Some of the jit.gl.sketch OB3D attributes are exposes through jam.jit.gl.ilda.sketch. These are marked with [OB3D] in the description.

Opacity
ILDA files do not contain opacitity values because they are commands for laser beam movement and colors. However, for screen rendering with jam.jit.gl.ilda.sketch you can apply opacities in two different ways:
Globally to all lines by setting the overrideopacity attribute to 1 (enabled) and set the opacity with the opacityattribute
For rendering frames that use indexed colors: by setting the custompalette attribute to 1 (enabled) and defining custom pallet colors that have opacity values
